issue.title: test_comprehensive_confirmation_stays_open_when_submit_collides fails under the full parallel lane, passes in isolation
issue.description:
PROPOSED BY: closed phase bead sase-o9.4 (2026-08-17), which recorded it as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP; routed here by the sase-o9 land agent.

NODE: tests/ace/tui/test_plugins_browser_pane_comprehensive_update_confirmation.py::test_comprehensive_confirmation_stays_open_when_submit_collides

OBSERVED: 2026-08-17, during sase-o9.4's mandatory verification. `just test-scoped` escalated to the full 2827-file suite under a 4-worker xdist run and this node was the single failure (1405 passed / 1 failed). It failed on a 5s `expect_modal` timeout waiting for `PluginActionConfirmModal`. It passes reliably when run in isolation. The phase's own change (Procs pane Enter-to-agent navigation) does not touch the plugins browser pane, its modals, or their fixtures.

SHAPE: the familiar CPU-contention timing sensitivity — a bounded modal wait that is generous when the worker has a core to itself and too tight when four workers share the box.

SCOPE: re-measure first (`just test-contention` on this node, and check `tools/selection_health` records for prior failures of this node — it is NOT currently in tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt). Then decide between a real fix (await the actual mount/message-pump event rather than polling with a fixed deadline) and a longer or serial-marked wait. Prefer the former: the repo's `tools/check_test_wait_helpers` policy exists to discourage attempt-bounded pause loops.

VERIFICATION: repeated `just test-contention` runs on the node with no red repeats, plus `just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake` clean.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ct — retired historical umbrella for the ACE TUI full-parallel/xdist flake class. Its close reason forbids +1 and reopen and directs exactly this route: a narrow, node-named task with fresh measurements. Read its close note for the measurement protocol (just test-contention, just test-visual-contention when snapshots are involved, tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt) before re-measuring.

RELATED: sase-j7 — in-progress epic fixing the sase-ct flake class at its root (process-global state leaking between tests). Not a duplicate and not the cause: check whether its root-cause work already covers this node's mechanism before writing a node-local fix here, and whether a fix here would collide with it.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced 2026-08-19 during just test-scoped on an unrelated glossary-read ACE hint change. The scoped run escalated to the full 9-worker lane (33986 items). This node was the only failure: AssertionError: expect_state('modal', 'PluginActionConfirmModal') timed out after 5.0s — last value was 'ConfigCenterModal'. Same tree, serial rerun: pytest tests/ace/tui/test_plugins_browser_pane_comprehensive_update_confirmation.py::test_comprehensive_confirmation_stays_open_when_submit_collides -q passed in 3.90s. Fail rate this session: 1/2 (failed under xdist, passed isolated). Not caused by the glossary hint work.

Independent reproduction from epic sase-qv landing (2026-08-19, workspace sase_14, HEAD be6077c7f plus the land agent's integration diff). Monitored 'just check-full' passed every lint gate, SASE validation, and committed-plan validation, then the test-cost lane reported '1 failed, 34517 passed, 12 skipped, 73 warnings in 2785.73s (0:46:25)' with this node as the ONLY failure -- a 5-worker xdist run on a host where three other agents were running their own suites, so the same CPU-contention shape this bead describes. Isolated rerun passed immediately (1 passed in 8.60s, 5.15s call), and the whole file passed 5/5 in 25.50s. The sase-qv diff is monitor status labels/colors plus a wait-dependency archive-classification fix; it touches nothing in the plugins browser pane, its modals, or their fixtures. Second independent report of this node.
